summary.text: Randal Mangham is a Democratic member of the Georgia State Senate, District 55, who took office on January 13, 2025, after serving in the Georgia House of Representatives from 2001 to 2011, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026. He is president of Metropolitan Management Corporation.

paragraphs.text: Randal Mangham's professional experience includes serving as president of the Metropolitan Management Corporation, as city attorney and city judge in the City of Greenville from 1990 to 1992, and as a partner in the law firm of Kendall, Mangham, Kendall and Hurst from 1981 to 1985.
He was a founding board member of the Georgia Association of African American Attorneys and a board member of the South DeKalb Community Development Corporation.
Mangham represented District 94 in the Georgia House from 2001 to 2011 and ran unopposed for re-election in 2008.
He appeared on the Democratic primary ballot for governor in 2010, receiving 0.8 percent of the vote.
He defeated Iris Hamilton in the June 18, 2024 Democratic primary runoff for Senate District 55, succeeding Gloria Butler.

For 2025-2026 he was assigned to the Banking and Financial Institutions; Health and Human Services; Interstate Cooperation; Metropolitan Atlanta Rapid Transit Overview; Retirement; and State and Local Governmental Operations committees.
